title: Pre-Visit Language Access for LEP Patients
summary: Learn how to build pre-visit language access for patients with limited English proficiency, including interpreter setup, preparation instructions, forms, medications, and telehealth.
body_markdown:
###


Pre-visit language access prepares a patient for the clinical encounter in a language they can use. It includes language identification, interpreter setup, appointment instructions, forms, medication preparation, and clinician handoff.


###


Identify it as early as possible, ideally during scheduling or before the appointment. The information should remain visible through registration, rooming, and the clinical encounter.


###


Focus on information the patient must act on before arrival, such as fasting, medication holds, transportation, arrival time, forms, testing, and telehealth instructions.


###


Yes. AI medical interpretation can support patient calls, preparation instructions, medication review, appointment questions, and telehealth setup before the clinical encounter.


###


Capture language information early, make interpretation easy to start, send usable preparation instructions, support multilingual intake, and carry the language need into the clinician workflow.
